All work

Brand identity, advertising & copy

Rent Extraordinary

Lendlease wanted a Build to Rent brand campaign that was unlike anything else on the market. The hidden challenge? To sell rental property during lockdown. Delivered on behalf of Chocolate Ltd.

The work

Invention

RENT EXTRAORDINARY For those who want it all. For everyone who expects the best and lives for the extras. For the wildly ambitious, and the deeply indulgent who love big-city life, and endless opportunity.

THE CHALLENGE

To stand out in a crowded market, appealing to a carefully selected audience and their precise wants and needs. But in more commercial terms, we needed to sell out two buildings at Park Central, Elephant Park – during lockdown.

THE ANSWER

Our campaign line was an active CTA designed to resonate with the audience mindset. The artwork merged highly stylised backgrounds with unique and aspirational individuals, placing people who are typical of the target audience, on a head turning backdrop of their own creation.

The campaign reached across print, socials, OOH and brochure sales assets.
